caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a fish, carved from wood, situated horizontally in the center of a plain, off-white or beige background. The fish is shown in profile, facing to the right, with detailed wood grain texture visible across its body, giving the impression of a grayish tone with darker streaks and knots typical of wood. The fins, tail, and head are all carved as part of the singular block-like piece. A round eye is etched into the head, and a simple mouth is indicated. There are two cylindrical poles or rods intersecting vertically through the upper and lower portions of the fish, appearing to secure it in place or serve as a mounting support. There are no other objects, decorations, or background details present in the image.
title: Fish Weather Vane
